key_stat: 19M customers | NatWest, RBS, Ulster Bank, Coutts brands
summary: NatWest is a major UK bank serving 19M customers across NatWest, RBS, Ulster Bank, and Coutts brands. CEO Paul Thwaite. Government stake reducing.
